dailyActivity.headline: Tell her which part worked.
dailyActivity.text: When something a woman made helps you, tell her the exact part and why. Perhaps her map made the meeting place easy to find, or her explanation cleared up one confusing step. Give her a detail she can use again, rather than leaving her to decode “Great job.”
